document.name: Appellant's Opening Brief — Halcyon Dynamics, Inc. v. Meridian Freight Systems, LLC (No. 26-1187, fictional)

pages.text: Q. What happened at the loading dock? A. The trailer arrived at the dock around 4 p.m. and the seal was already broken when our team inspected it at 4:10 p.m.
Q. Who signed the delivery receipt? A. Mr. Beltran signed the delivery receipt at 4:20 p.m. without noting any exception on the document.

Q. Was the cargo ever weighed? A. We weighed the pallets the next morning and found a shortfall of 340 kilograms against the manifest. The manifest itself listed 12,480 kilograms of freight on the outbound leg, and the reweigh at the Millbrook terminal showed only 12,140 kilograms, a difference the intake team documented in the overflow log and reported to the dispatch office that same afternoon.

paragraphs.text: On the afternoon of March 3, 2025, I photographed the pallets before they were removed from the dock area.
The photographs show water staining on four of the eleven pallets delivered under this shipment.
